CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION atlas_account_private.capture_request()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  update atlas_account_private.operations set request=jsonb_build_object(
    'role',new.raw_app_meta_data->>'role',
    'warehouse_code',new.raw_app_meta_data->>'home_warehouse_code',
    'login_name',new.raw_app_meta_data->>'login_name',
    'display_name',new.raw_user_meta_data->>'display_name')
    where operation_id=(new.raw_app_meta_data->>'atlas_assignment_operation_id')::uuid and request is null;
  return new;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.atlas_account_admin_snapshot(p_actor uuid, p_operation uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare answer jsonb;
begin
  if p_operation is not null then
    select jsonb_build_object('user_id',o.user_id,'revision',o.revision,'request',o.request)
      into answer from atlas_account_private.operations o join auth.users u on u.id=o.actor_id
      where o.operation_id=p_operation and o.actor_id=p_actor and u.deleted_at is null
        and (u.banned_until is null or u.banned_until<=now());
    return answer;
  end if;
  if not exists(select 1 from auth.users u join public.profiles p on p.user_id=u.id
    where u.id=p_actor and u.deleted_at is null and p.role='admin'
      and (u.banned_until is null or u.banned_until<=now())
      and (u.raw_app_meta_data->>'role' in ('admin','administrator')
        or u.raw_app_meta_data->>'atlas_role' in ('admin','administrator'))) then
    raise exception 'ADMINISTRATOR_REQUIRED' using errcode='42501';
  end if;
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'id',u.id,'display_name',coalesce(p.display_name,u.raw_user_meta_data->>'display_name',split_part(u.email,'@',1)),
    'login_name',coalesce(u.raw_app_meta_data->>'login_name',split_part(u.email,'@',1)),
    'role',coalesce(u.raw_app_meta_data->>'atlas_role',u.raw_app_meta_data->>'role',p.role::text,'picker'),
    'warehouse_code',w.code,'warehouse_access',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(wa.code order by wa.code)
      from public.profile_warehouse_access a join public.warehouses wa on wa.id=a.warehouse_id and wa.active where a.user_id=u.id),'[]'::jsonb),
    'assignment_revision',coalesce((u.raw_app_meta_data->>'atlas_assignment_revision')::bigint,0),
    'active',(u.banned_until is null or u.banned_until<=now()),'last_sign_in_at',u.last_sign_in_at,
    'created_at',u.created_at,'is_current',u.id=p_actor) order by u.id),'[]'::jsonb)
    into answer from auth.users u left join public.profiles p on p.user_id=u.id
    left join public.warehouses w on w.id=p.warehouse_id where u.deleted_at is null;
  return answer;
end $function$
